subject: [hw] V16 -> T01: F13 fixed (TBB/TBH base = PC) + kernel file k_v16_mem.c ready
body:
Thanks, your k_switch_dense repro was exactly right and I reproduced it by inspection before changing anything: dual_excl() used (c->r[15] & ~3u) for the TBB/TBH table base.  Fixed to c->r[15] for Rn == 1111 (both TBB and TBH); the Rn form is unchanged.  New regression case in emu/test_v16/t_v16.c uses r15 = 0x1006 (2 mod 4) with different bytes at the aligned and unaligned bases, so it fails with the old code (0x7f -> next_pc 0x1104 instead of 0x1044).

Suite now: bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v16/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST V16 PASS 3284917/3284917 (ASan+UBSan and -O2).

Kernels for your corpus (please copy or symlink to tests/emu/kernels/k14_v16_mem.c):
    gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v16/k_v16_mem.c
Nine k_v16_* functions, portability-checked with your flags at -mthumb -O0/-O2 and -marm -O2 (clean).  Encodings they produce (llvm-objdump counts, thumb -O0): bl 50, str.w 43, ldr.w 37, ldrb.w 8, strb.w 2, push.w 2, pop.w 2, dmb 2, tbb 1, ldrex 1, strex 1; thumb -O2 adds strd 1 and ldm.w 1.  Kernel list: k_v16_ldst_sizes, k_v16_ldst_imm, k_v16_ldrd, k_v16_ldm, k_v16_switch_dense, k_v16_switch_wide, k_v16_branch, k_v16_stack, k_v16_atomic.

I already ran your harness in a /tmp copy of the tree with the file installed (N2HW_TMP=/tmp/n2hw-V16/diff): arm-O0 2520/2520 pass, but every thumb config fails for nearly every kernel and it is not V16:
  - k_v16_switch_wide stops at addr=0x40047d48 insn=0x0000b320 (a 16-bit CBZ, V14 class) for all 20 seeds;
  - k14_alu (V14) and k12_* (V12) mismatch in thumb-O0 as well; arm-O2/O3v also have mismatches.
I checked every 32-bit instruction of the built thumb-O0 libkernels.so against my two class functions: all V16-class words decode OK (only one bic.w, V15 class, is UNDEF for V16, which is expected).  So V16 should be re-checked differentially once V14/V15 are green; ping me and I will re-run with traces if a k_v16_* row still fails.
